capabilities: Draw a note hierarchy as a Bases view rooted at the embedded note
Define note types by tag, folder or property in the view
Link children to parents through a link property or parent-side links
Add, move and retype notes directly on the graph
Focus the view on a single node and its subtree
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A Bases view that draws a note hierarchy starting from the note it is embedded in.
problem: Obsidian's Bases and graph views do not show an editable parent-child hierarchy of typed notes that you can restructure in place.
summary: Bases view that draws a typed note hierarchy starting from the embedded note and lets you add, move and retype notes directly on the graph.
